def squash(s: str) -> str:
    out: list[str] = []
    n = len(s)
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        ch = s[i]
        j = i + 1
        while j < n and s[j] == ch:
            j += 1
        run_len = j - i
        esc = f"\\{ch}" if ("0" <= ch <= "9" or ch == "\\") else ch
        out.append(f"{run_len}{esc}" if run_len >= 3 else esc * run_len)
        i = j
    return "".join(out)
